item.title: Black Student Union is returning to its roots of political activism

item.title: Cal Poly’s first ever Field Quarter is happening this spring
item.description: Cal Poly professors from across majors are hosting a Field Quarter this spring, combining field botany, herpetology and ornithology into a single class, which will take students to state and national parks for weeks at a time.
